title: Thermodynamic model for methanesulphonic acid recovery by tri-n-butyl phosphate
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18154-18165
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00938G, Paper
Open Access

Rayco Lommelen, Charlotte Lempereur, Koen Binnemans
Protonation and molecular transfer are modelled from new experimental data, enabling predictive simulation of up to 94% acid recycling from a 1.5 mol L−1 nickel methanesulphonate solution.
